topics.title: Present Perfect Continuous
topics.tip: Süre (for/since/how long) → PPC. 'ago' ve 'start/begin' ile kullanılmaz. know, own, need gibi durum fiilleri -ing almaz.

topics.title: Present Perfect Simple vs Continuous
topics.tip: Sayı / 'kaç tane' / tamamlanmış iş → Simple. Süreç, süre, yorgunluk, şimdi görülen iz → Continuous.

topics.title: First vs Second Conditional
topics.tip: if'li kısımda will/would YOK. 1. tip gerçek ihtimal; 2. tip hayal. If I were you… her özneyle were.

topics.title: Future Continuous
topics.tip: Gelecekte belirli bir anda 'o sırada yapıyor olacağım' → will be + V-ing. Kibar plan sorusu: Will you be using…?

topics.title: Modal verbs review
topics.tip: must = zorunluluk, mustn't = yasak, don't have to = gerek yok, should = tavsiye, may/might = olasılık/izin.

topics.title: Modals + have + V3
topics.tip: must have (≈%90) › might/could/may have (≈%50) › can't have (%0). Pişmanlık: should have + V3. needn't have = gereksiz yaptın.

topics.title: used to · would · would rather / prefer
topics.tip: used to = geçmiş durum + alışkanlık; would = sadece tekrarlanan eylem (durum fiili yok). Olumsuz: didn't use to. would rather + V1 (than V1); prefer A to B.

topics.title: Linking verbs · Stative vs dynamic
topics.tip: look/sound/taste/feel/seem/smell + SIFAT (adverb değil). Durum fiilleri (know, own, believe) continuous almaz. be + being = geçici davranış.

topics.title: Past simple vs past continuous
topics.tip: Arka plan / uzun eylem: was V-ing. Araya giren / ardışık kısa eylem: V2. while → continuous, when → genelde simple.

topics.title: Past perfect
topics.tip: had + V3 = geçmişte daha önce olan. by the time, before, after, already, never … before ipuçları.

topics.title: Relative clauses
topics.tip: who (insan), which (şey), that (ikisi, virgülsüz), whose (aitlik), where (yer), when (zaman). Virgüllü cümlede that yok.

topics.title: Wish / If only (4A ön çalışma)
topics.tip: Şimdi → wish + V2/were; geçmiş → wish + had V3; şikâyet → wish + sb + would. 'I wish I would…' yanlış.

grammar.title: Wish / If only
grammar.formula: şimdi: wish + V2 / were · geçmiş: wish + had V3 · şikâyet: wish + sb + would V1
grammar.note: Wish, gerçeğin tersini dile getirir ve bir adım geriye gider: şimdiki durum → past simple, geçmiş → past perfect. If only = daha güçlü wish. Resmi dilde her özneyle were: I wish I were taller. Kendi davranışın için would kullanılmaz (I wish I could…).
examples: I wish I were lying on a beach right now.
She wishes she could have stayed one more day.
I wish the vendor would answer my emails.
If only we had stayed at home with pizza and Netflix.

topics.title: Conditionals 0–3 (4A ön çalışma)
topics.tip: 0: if+pres, pres · 1: if+pres, will · 2: if+V2, would V1 · 3: if+had V3, would have V3. if'li kısımda will/would olmaz.

grammar.title: Conditionals 0–3
grammar.formula: 0: if + present, present · 1: if + present, will V1 · 2: if + past simple, would V1 · 3: if + past perfect, would have V3
grammar.note: 0 = her zaman doğru; 1 = gerçek olası gelecek; 2 = hayali şimdi/gelecek; 3 = geçmişte olmayan durum ve sonucu. If'li kısımda will/would kullanılmaz. 3. tipte ana cümle would have + V3.
examples: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
If the client approves the design, we will start next week.
If the weather were better, we could go swimming.
If they had taken the earlier flight, they wouldn't have missed their hotel shuttle.

bank.q: She ___ on the report since 8 a.m.
bank.e: since + başlangıç noktası, hâlâ devam ediyor → has been + V-ing.

bank.q: How long ___ for the client's reply?
bank.e: How long + süre sorusu, süreç hâlâ sürüyor → PPC.

bank.q: Her eyes are red. She ___.
bank.e: Şimdiki durumun kanıtı olan yakın geçmiş süreç → PPC.

bank.q: Which sentence is correct?
o: I have been learning English for two years.
I have been learning English two years ago.
I have been learn English for two years.
I have been learning English since two years.
bank.e: PPC 'ago' almaz; for + süre, since + başlangıç.

bank.q: Which verb is NOT normally used in the Present Perfect Continuous?
bank.e: Durum fiilleri (know, own, need, want) -ing almaz: I have known him for years.

bank.q: It ___ all day, so the site is muddy.
bank.e: Sonucu şimdi görülen uzun süreç → PPC.

bank.q: They ___ in this city since March.
The pump ___ for six hours without a problem.
I ___ twelve drawings today.
I ___ my keys. I can't find them.
bank.e: Şimdiki sonucu olan tek bir olay → PPS.

bank.q: How many pages ___ so far?
Which sentence suggests the job is finished?
bank.e: Simple = tamamlanmış sonuç; Continuous = süreç (bitmiş olması şart değil).

bank.q: I ___ this phone since 2022.
This is the first time I ___ sushi.
bank.e: This is the first time + PPS.

bank.q: She ___ four cups of coffee already today.
I ___ for you for an hour! Where were you?
If the vendor ___ the drawings today, I'll check them tonight.
bank.e: 1. tip: if + present simple, will V1.

bank.q: If I ___ you, I would ask for a second opinion.
If it rains, we ___ the site visit.
If I had more time, I ___ a course.
Which sentence is imaginary / unlikely?
o: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a villa.
If I win the lottery, I'll buy a villa.
If it's sunny, we'll go out.
If you mix red and blue, you get purple.

bank.q: If she ___ harder, she'd pass the exam.
bank.e: if'li kısımda would olmaz; past simple.

bank.q: We'll miss the train ___ we hurry.
What would you do if you ___ a million dollars?
This time tomorrow I ___ on a plane.
bank.e: Gelecekte belli bir anda sürmekte olacak eylem → will be + V-ing.

bank.q: Don't call at 8; we ___ dinner.
bank.e: Gelecekte belli saatte devam eden eylem.

bank.q: Future Continuous formula is:
At 10 a.m. next Monday, the welders ___ the main line.
___ you using the car tonight?
bank.e: Will you be using…? = kibar soru / plan sorusu.

bank.q: Next year she ___ here any more.
This time next week we ___ on the beach.
You ___ wear a helmet on site. It's compulsory.
You ___ bring a pen; we have plenty.
You ___ smoke here. It's forbidden.
He ___ speak three languages when he was five.
___ I borrow your pen? (polite)
bank.e: Kibar izin: May I…? / Could I…?

bank.q: You look ill. You ___ see a doctor.
It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
She ___ be at home; her car is outside.
The lights are off. They ___ gone home. (I'm sure)
He ___ at the meeting; he was abroad. (impossible)
You ___ called me! I waited all night. (criticism)
I'm not sure, but she ___ the wrong bus.
'You needn't have brought food.' means:
o: It wasn't necessary, but you did it.
bank.e: needn't have + V3 = gereksiz yere yaptın.

bank.q: He must have ___ early.
The door was open, so I ___ have locked it.
bank.e: Kapı açık → kilitlememiş olmalıyım: olanaksız çıkarım.

bank.q: Which expresses the HIGHEST certainty?
I ___ have long hair, but now it's short. (state)
bank.e: Durumlar için would kullanılmaz; used to.

bank.q: Which sentence CANNOT use 'would' instead of 'used to'?
o: We used to play football every Sunday.
He used to walk to school.
They used to visit us each year.
bank.e: would sadece tekrarlanan eylemler için; be/have/know gibi durumlarda yok.

bank.q: I ___ like coffee, but now I love it.
bank.e: Olumsuz/soru: didn't use to / Did you use to…?

bank.q: Did you ___ play chess?
I'd rather ___ at home tonight.
I'd rather you ___ smoke here. (başkasına)
bank.e: would rather + özne + past simple (şimdi/gelecek tercih).

bank.q: I prefer tea ___ coffee.
I'd prefer ___ the report tomorrow.
I'd rather walk than ___ the bus.
bank.e: would rather A than B (ikisi de V1).

bank.q: The soup tastes ___.
bank.e: Linking verb (taste, look, sound, feel, seem) + sıfat.

bank.q: She looks ___ today.
That idea sounds ___.
Which verb is stative?
bank.e: Durum fiilleri: own, know, belong, need, want, believe.

bank.q: I ___ the answer.
'He is being rude today.' means:
The weather got ___ in the evening.
The milk smells ___.
I ___ the drawings when the power went off.
bank.e: Uzun eylem (arka plan) → continuous; araya giren kısa eylem → simple.

bank.q: While we ___ lunch, the alarm rang.
She ___ the door and walked in.
I ___ TV at 9 last night.
bank.e: Geçmişte belli anda süren eylem → past continuous.

bank.q: What ___ when I called?
He ___ down the street when he saw an accident.
It ___ when we left the office.
I fell asleep while I ___ a book.
By the time we arrived, the meeting ___.
bank.e: By the time + daha önce tamamlanmış olay → past perfect.

bank.q: She had never ___ sushi before she went to Tokyo.
After he ___ the report, he went home.
I couldn't enter because I ___ my key.
Past perfect formula:
When I got to the station, the train ___.
He said he ___ the contract.
bank.e: Dolaylı anlatımda geçmişten önceki olay → had + V3.

bank.q: The patient ___ before the doctor arrived.
The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
The pump, ___ was installed in 2010, needs repair.
That's the man ___ car was stolen.
This is the office ___ I work.
The book ___ I bought yesterday is great.
I remember the day ___ we met.
After a comma you can NOT use:
Everything ___ he said was true.
I wish I ___ a car. (I don't have one)
I wish I ___ for the exam yesterday.
I wish he ___ stop talking.
bank.e: Başkasının davranışından şikâyet → wish + sb + would.

bank.q: If only I ___ more money!
I wish I ___ taller.
They wish they ___ $500. (they spent it)
Which sentence is WRONG?
o: I wish I would be taller.
I wish I had a car.
bank.e: Kendi durumun için wish + would kullanılmaz.

bank.q: I wish I ___ speak German. (I can't)
If you heat water to 100°C, it ___.
If the client approves the design, we ___ next week.
If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
If they had taken the earlier flight, they ___ the shuttle.
bank.e: 3. tip: if + had V3, would have V3.

bank.q: If we ___ the line, we would have found the leak.
If he had studied harder, he ___ the exam.
Which is a THIRD conditional?
o: If I had known, I would have told you.
If I knew, I would tell you.
If I know, I will tell you.
If you mix red and blue, you get purple.

bank.q: If you don't hurry, you ___ the train.
Which sentence is correct?
o: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the visit.
If it will rain tomorrow, we cancel the visit.
If it would rain tomorrow, we cancel the visit.
If it rained tomorrow, we'll cancel the visit.

bank.q: If it ___ yesterday, we would have stayed at the hotel.
